newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs fall on rumour of cut in outright JGB buying.
newsitem.headline: JGBs fall on rumour of cut in outright JGB buying.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Wednesday's Tokyo session down, as dealers liquidated longs on vague market rumours.
June ended at an intraday low of 126.60, down from Tuesday's close of 126.98. Turnover was 42,607 lots.

The late afternoon fall was triggered by a vague rumour that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may reduce the amount of its outright bond purchases. BOJ officials were not immediately available to comment on the rumour.
The BOJ currently conducts outright JGB purchase operations twice a month, buying 100 billion yen each time.
